# Creator Signals

> Creator Signals (creatorsignals.blog) is an independent educational platform for beginner and growing TikTok creators. It sells two downloadable courses and offers free tools and a free starter workbook. It is not affiliated with TikTok. Content is written in British English for creators worldwide; TikTok features were checked with a UK account in November 2026.

Teaching method: Learn → Create → Test → Analyse → Improve. Creator Signals does not promise views, followers, income or viral videos; it teaches a repeatable method and decisions based on the creator's own data.

## Courses

- [30-Day Creator Launchpad](https://creatorsignals.blog/academy/launchpad/): beginner course. 30 daily lessons of 10–15 minutes with one task each. Course Book (PDF, 137 pages), fillable Workbook (61 pages), Analytics Tracker (Excel / Google Sheets), Content Calendar, 50-Hook Library, templates and a worked example. Launch price €19 until 30 November 2026, then €39. One-time payment, incl. VAT, 14-day money-back guarantee.
- [90-Day Growth Accelerator](https://creatorsignals.blog/academy/accelerator/): for creators who finished the basics. 3 phases, 12 modules: formats, workflow, measurement, storytelling, search strategy, experiments, community, brand, monetisation fundamentals, portfolio, media kit and UGC. Course Book (480 pages), Interactive Workbook (178 pages), Creator OS spreadsheet (12 sheets), 90-Day Planner (49 pages). Launch price €49 until 30 November 2026, then €99.
- [Free sample lesson: Day 8, Understanding TikTok Hooks](https://creatorsignals.blog/academy/launchpad/day-8-hooks/)

## Free resources

- [Creator Starter Kit](https://creatorsignals.blog/starter-kit/): free 14-page fillable PDF — niche finder, 10 hook formulas, 7-day content plan, 7-video tracker. No sign-up.
- [Free creator tools](https://creatorsignals.blog/tools/): Hook Builder and Engagement Calculator.
- [30-Day Content Planner](https://creatorsignals.blog/tools/content-planner/)
